description:
The Government requires a follow-on, non-personal services contract to provide 24/7/365 intrusion detection system monitoring and remote telephonic technical support for three (3) of its community-based clinics. The Intrusion Detection and Duress systems at the specified locations are Government Furnished Equipment (GFE).

The contractor shall provide:

  • Alarm Monitoring & Reporting: Continuous (24/7/365, including public holidays) monitoring of the Intrusion Detection System. Upon alarm activation, the contractor shall immediately notify designated Government personnel and/or local authorities.
  • Technical Support: Provide telephone-based technical support to Government personnel during normal business hours to assist in performing system maintenance and repairs.

See attached Sources Sought Notice
